title: Red Teaming test runs: units, new runs, scheduling and history

checks.do: Before reading a Scheduled tab column as the last or next execution, that the page's column text is a copy of the History tab's, so what Last Run and Next Run show is not established.
That the account has units remaining before expecting a run to start.

definition.statement: A Test Run is a group of executed probes performed at a specific point in time against an AI app in Zscaler AI Security; in each test run the user chooses which vulnerabilities to test by selecting one or more pre-configured probes.

quotes: A Test Run is a group of executed probes performed at a specific point in time against your AI app in the Zscaler AI Security.
In each test run, you can choose which vulnerabilities to test by selecting one or more pre-configured probes.

units.statement: The New Test Run window header shows the Current Units, the Test Run Cost and the Remaining Units; units are the organization's consumption credits for running AI Security evaluations (eg, red teaming, test runs), starting a test run deducts the required units from the available balance, and if not enough units remain the Zscaler Account team is to be contacted.

quotes: The header shows the Current Units, the Test Run Cost, and the Remaining Units.
Units are your organization’s consumption credits for running AI Security evaluations (eg, red teaming, test runs).
When you start a test run, the platform deducts the required units from your available balance. If you don't have sufficient units remaining, contact your Zscaler Account team.

new-run-fields.statement: A new test run takes a Business Unit, an AI app, a Test Run Name and a Probe Selection; with the Receive email notification option enabled, the user who initiated the run receives an email with the test run details and the generated PDF report attached after it completes, and Schedule for Later schedules it for later.

quotes: Select Business Unit: Select the Business Unit from the drop-down menu.
Select AI App: Select the AI app on which you want to perform the test run from the drop-down menu.
Test Run Name: Enter a name for your test run.
Probe Selection: Select probes from the available list of probes.

Receive email notification: Enable this option to receive email notifications. After the test run completes, the user who initiated it receives an email with the test run details and the generated PDF report attached.
Schedule for Later: Select to schedule a test run for later.

scheduler.statement: The scheduler sets up recurring or single-run executions that run in the background, with a Schedule Date, Schedule Time and Frequency (Single Run, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly); a scheduled test run is listed in the AI Infrastructure > AI Red Teaming - Test Runs > Scheduled tab, where Edit edits a test run and Delete deletes it entirely, and deleting requires typing CONFIRM.

quotes: Instead of manually setting up tests every time you want to validate model behavior, scheduler allows you to set up recurring or single-run executions that run in the background.
Choose a Schedule Date, Schedule Time, and Frequency (i.e., Single Run, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly) for execution.
Type CONFIRM to delete.
The scheduled test run gets listed in the AI Infrastructure > AI Red Teaming - Test Runs > Scheduled tab.
Actions: Select Edit to edit a test run or Delete to delete the test run entirely.

history.statement: The Test Run History tab lists all test runs associated with a single AI app, including those in progress, sorted chronologically with the most recent at the top by default; Status filters by Running, Error, Finished, or Canceled, and each run shows who launched it, its timestamp, status, probes, and the total number of passed, failed and error test cases across all probes.

quotes: The Test Run History tab provides a comprehensive list of all test runs associated with a single AI app, including those currently in progress.
By default, test runs are sorted chronologically, with the most recent run appearing at the top.
Launched By: Name of the user who launched the test run.
Result: Shows the total number of passed, failed and error test cases across all probes
Status: Filter by test run status (i.e., Running, Error, Finished, or Canceled).
Timestamp: Test run's execution date and time.
Status: Current status of the test run.
Probes: Probes included in the test run.

scheduled-columns.summary: On the About Test Runs page the Scheduled tab's Last Run and Next Run columns carry the History tab's Launched By and Timestamp text word for word.

quotes: Last Run: Name of the user who launched the test run.
Next Run: Test run's execution date and time.

positions.says: The Scheduled tab's Last Run column is described as a user name and its Next Run column as an execution date and time.

quotes: Launched By: Name of the user who launched the test run.
Timestamp: Test run's execution date and time.

positions.says: The History tab's Launched By column carries the same user-name text and its Timestamp column the same date-and-time text.

scheduled-columns.impact: A column named Last Run described as a user name, and Next Run as an execution time, reads as text copied from the History tab; what the two columns hold is not established, so neither is claimed.

units-cost.title: A run's unit cost, how units are bought, and AI Guard's accounting
units-cost.detail: The New Test Run window shows the run's cost, but no captured Red Teaming page gives a cost per run or probe, or how units are purchased; the family's packaging gap stays open for those and for AI Guard's accounting. The September 2026 release summary's Rerun Action for Test Runs says no additional units are charged for reruns, though results may vary if the configuration or probe versions changed. The API's test-run and probe-run responses carry totalUnitsCharged and unitsCharged, which the hub's API gap notes.

quotes: No additional units are charged for reruns, though results may vary if the test run configuration or probe versions have changed since the original run.

schedule-details.title: The schedule's time zone, result retention and PDF report contents
schedule-details.detail: The scheduling and test-run articles do not state the time zone the Schedule Time uses, how long results are retained, or what the PDF report contains.
